16776:             esac
16777:             ;;
16778:     esac
16779: }
16780: 
16781: # ==============================================================================
16782: # SECTION 10: Main Command Router
16783: # Routes callbacks and text messages to the appropriate sub-handler.
16784: # STATE_FILE intercepts text input for multi-step flows.
16785: # ==============================================================================
16786: handle_command() {
16787:     local cmd="$1" mid="$2" cb_id="$3"
16788: 
16789:     # Tailscale recovery path: if the shared STATE_FILE vanished during the
16790:     # URL → hostname → key wizard, recover the pending non-secret step from the
16791:     # dedicated per-chat file. The auth key is never persisted. Never hijack the
16792:     # persistent Status/Menu keys.
16793:     if [ -z "$cb_id" ] && [ ! -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
16794:         case "$cmd" in
16795:             cmd_status) : ;;
16796:             /menu|/start|main_menu|"🏠 Меню"|"🏠Menu")
16797:                 _ts_pending_clear
16798:                 ;;
16799:             /cancel|cancel)
16800:                 if _ts_pending_url >/dev/null 2>&1; then
16801:                     _ts_pending_clear
16802:                     send_message "$(printf '%s Действие отменено.' "$E_BACK")" ""
16803:                     _handle_bot "main_menu" "$mid" "" ""
16804:                     return
16805:                 fi
16806:                 ;;
16807:             *)
16808:                 local _ts_recover_state
16809:                 _ts_recover_state=$(_ts_pending_stage 2>/dev/null)
16810:                 if [ -n "$_ts_recover_state" ]; then
16811:                     logger -t podkop-bot "[ts] recovered ${_ts_recover_state} from dedicated pending state"
16812:                     _handle_forkop_ext "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$_ts_recover_state"
16813:                     return
16814:                 fi
16815:                 ;;
16816:         esac
16817:     fi
16818: 
16819:     # State machine: intercept plain text (not callbacks) for multi-step input
16820:     if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ] && [ -z "$cb_id" ]; then
16821:         local state; state=$(head -n 1 "$STATE_FILE")
16822:         # Persistent keyboard navigation must win over pending text input.
16823:         # normalize_reply_button() maps Status to cmd_status before dispatch.
16824:         if [ "$1" = "cmd_status" ]; then
16825:             rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
16826:             _handle_bot "cmd_status" "$mid" "" ""
16827:             return
16828:         fi
16829: 
16830:         # Universal exit: /cancel or Menu always clears state
16831:         case "$1" in
16832:             /cancel|cancel|/menu|/start|main_menu|"🏠 Меню"|"🏠Menu")
16833:                 rm -f "$STATE_FILE"
16834:                 case "$1" in /cancel|cancel)
16835:                     send_message "$(printf '%s Действие отменено.' "$E_BACK")" "" ;;
16836:                 esac
16837:                 _handle_bot "main_menu" "$mid" "" ""
16838:                 return ;;
16839:         esac
16840:         if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^/(start|menu)'; then
16841:             rm -f "$STATE_FILE"; _handle_bot "main_menu" "$mid" "" ""; return
16842:         fi
16843:         case "$state" in
16844:             wait_ts_url|wait_ts_hostname|wait_ts_key) logger -t podkop-bot "[ts] dispatcher state=$state" ;;
16845:         esac
16846:         case "$state" in
16847:             wait_proxy_link|pending_sub_url_*|wait_forkop_sub_url|pending_forkop_sub_url|wait_netshift_sub_url|pending_netshift_sub_url)
16848:                 _handle_proxy "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16849:             wait_sub_url_*)
16850:                 _handle_proxy "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16851:             wait_url_link)
16852:                 _handle_url_links "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16853:             wait_fk_label|wait_fkdns_server|wait_fkpg_name|wait_fkpl_country_*)
16854:                 _handle_forkop_0198 "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" "" ;;
16855:             wait_fkc_*|wait_fkcd_*|wait_fkss_i_*|wait_fkss_px_*|wait_fkut_u_*|wait_fkut_i_*|wait_fkut_t_*|\
16856:             wait_ts_url|wait_ts_hostname|wait_ts_key)
16857:                 _handle_forkop_ext "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16858:             wait_fully_routed_ip|wait_excl_ip|wait_remote_domain|wait_remote_subnet|\
16859:             wait_user_domain_add|wait_user_domain_del|wait_user_subnet_add|wait_user_subnet_del|\
16860:             wait_utfilter_exc_*|wait_utfilter_inc_*|wait_dpi_strategy_*)
16861:                 _handle_lists "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16862:             wait_gdns_add_dns|wait_gdns_add_boot)
16863:                 _handle_dns_0198 "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16864:             wait_dns_server|wait_bootstrap_dns)
16865:                 _handle_dns "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16866:             wait_custom_proxy|wait_bind_iface|wait_restart_router_confirm)
16867:                 _handle_bot "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16868:             wait_admin_id|\
16869:             wait_fb_socks_add|wait_fb_edit_*)
16870:                 _handle_fallback_socks "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16871:             wait_quiet_hours|wait_dr_time|wait_wr_settings|wait_urltest_url|wait_urltest_interval|wait_urltest_tolerance|\
16872:             wait_dr_server|wait_badwan_ifaces|wait_badwan_delay|\
16873:             wait_mixed_port|wait_outbound_iface|wait_vpn_iface|wait_utl_link)
16874:                 _handle_section_extras "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16875:             wait_text_link)
16876:                 _handle_text_links "STATE_INPUT" "$mid" "$cmd" "$state" ;;
16877:         esac
16878:         return
16879:     fi
16880: 
16881:     case "$cmd" in
16882:         "noop") ;;
16883:         "doc_to_runtime") delete_message "$mid"; _handle_bot "cmd_runtime" "" "" "" ;;
16884:         "delete_msg")     delete_message "$mid" ;;
16885: 
16886:         # Explicit parent navigation for warning/read-only screens. Dispatched
16887:         # before feature handlers so a backend (Forkop) guard cannot intercept
16888:         # Back and re-show the same warning (loop).
16889:         nav_main_settings)    _handle_settings "main_settings_menu" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16890:         nav_section_settings) _handle_settings "section_settings" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16891:         nav_global_settings)  _handle_settings "global_settings" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16892:         nav_proxy_menu)       _handle_proxy "proxy_menu" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16893:         nav_routing)          _handle_lists "community_lists" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16894: 
16895:         proxy_menu|proxy_menu_p_*|px_view_*|do_px_*|do_del_px_*|test_px_*|\
16896:         cmd_proxy_add|ask_del_px_*|do_del_px_confirmed_*|cmd_all_delay_test|\
16897:         cmd_edit_sub_url|edit_fsub_*|edit_nsub_*|do_confirm_forkop_sub_url|do_confirm_netshift_sub_url|do_confirm_sub_url_*)
16898:             _handle_proxy "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16899: 
16900:         url_links_menu|url_links_p_*|\
16901:         cmd_url_link_add|ask_del_ul_*|do_del_ul_*|\
16902:         outbound_info)
16903:             _handle_url_links "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16904: 
16905:         text_links_menu|text_links_p_*|\
16906:         cmd_text_link_add|ask_del_txt_*|do_del_txt_*)
16907:             _handle_text_links "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16908: 
16909:         sections_menu|set_sec_*|do_set_sec_*)
16910:             _handle_sections "$cmd" "$mid" ;;
16911: 
16912:         main_settings_menu|advanced_settings|\
16913:         ask_toggle_dl|ask_toggle_quic|ask_toggle_wan|ask_toggle_ntp|ask_toggle_mixed|\
16914:         do_toggle_dl|do_toggle_quic|do_toggle_wan|do_toggle_ntp|do_toggle_mixed|\
16915:         proxy_mode_menu|ask_switch_mode_*|do_switch_mode_*|set_log_*|set_update_int_*|conn_type_menu|do_set_conn_*|ask_toggle_autostart_off|ask_toggle_autostart_on|do_autostart_off|do_autostart_on)
16916:             _handle_settings "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16917: 
16918:         # Generic section-extra callbacks belong to _handle_section_extras.
16919:         # This is especially important for Forkop: urltest_settings must enter
16920:         # the Forkop guard there, which redirects it to fk_ut_menu. Routing it
16921:         # directly to _handle_forkop_ext made the visible URLTest button a no-op.
16922:         urltest_settings|cmd_set_ut_url|cmd_set_ut_interval|cmd_set_ut_tolerance|\
16923:         urltest_links_menu|urltest_links_p_*|cmd_utl_add|ask_del_utl_*|do_del_utl_*|\
16924:         cmd_clone_sel_to_utl|cmd_clone_utl_to_sel|\
16925:         cmd_set_mixed_port|cmd_set_outbound_iface)
16926:             _handle_section_extras "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16927: 
16928:         fk_label|fk_sort_*|fk_dns_menu|fkdns_proto|fkdns_p_*|fkdns_server|\
16929:         fk_pg_menu|fkpg_*|fkpl_*)
16930:             _handle_forkop_0198 "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" "$cb_id" ;;
16931: 
16932:         fk_conds|fk_c_*|fkc_add_*|fkc_del_*|fk_dev_list|fk_dev_a_*|\
16933:         fk_detour|fkd_t_*|fkd_pick|fkd_s_*|\
16934:         fk_sub_set_*|fkss_u_*|fkss_v_*|fkss_m_*|fkss_p_*|fkss_i_*|fkss_px_*|fkss_vp_*|fkss_vs_*|\
16935:         fk_ut_menu|fk_ut_ed_*|fkut_u_*|fkut_i_*|fkut_t_*|fkut_e_*|\
16936:         fkutf_*|fkufm_*|fkuc_*|fkuca_*|fkucc_*|fkuflag_*|fkuo_*|fkuot_*|fkuoa_*|fkuoc_*|\
16937:         ts_add|ts_e_*|ts_x_*|ts_r_*)
16938:             _handle_forkop_ext "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" "$cb_id" ;;
16939: 
16940:         domain_resolver_settings|do_toggle_dr|set_dr_type_*|cmd_set_dr_server|\
16941:         badwan_details|cmd_set_bw_ifaces|cmd_set_bw_delay)
16942:             _handle_section_extras "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16943: 
16944:         gdn_dns|gdn_boot|gdn_a_*|gdn_u_*|gdn_d_*|gdn_x_*)
16945:             _handle_dns_0198 "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16946:         dns_settings|dns_proto_menu|do_dns_pr_*|cmd_dns_server|cmd_boot_dns)
16947:             _handle_dns "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16948:         section_settings|global_settings|\
16949:         zapret_section_menu|byedpi_section_menu|\
16950:         do_dpi_toggle_*)
16951:             _handle_settings "$cmd" "$mid" "$cid" "$cb_id" ;;
16952: 
16953:         urltest_filters_menu|\
16954:         do_utfilter_mode_*|do_utfilter_cycle_dc|do_utfilter_toggle_hide|\
16955:         puuc_*|puuca_*|puucc_*|puuflag_*|puuo_*|puuot_*|puuoa_*|puuoc_*)
16956:             _handle_section_extras "$cmd" "$mid" "$cid" "$cb_id" ;;
16957: 
16958:         wait_utfilter_exc_*|wait_utfilter_inc_*|\
16959:         wait_utfilter_excob_*|wait_utfilter_incob_*|\
16960:         do_utfilter_obpick_*|do_utfilter_obclear_*)
16961:             _handle_section_extras "$cmd" "$mid" "$cid" "$cb_id" ;;
16962: 
16963:         wait_dpi_strategy_*)
16964:             _handle_section_extras "$cmd" "$mid" "$cid" "$cb_id" ;;
16965:         cmd_maintenance)
16966:             _handle_bot "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16967:         yacd_settings|\
16968:         ask_toggle_yacd|do_toggle_yacd|\
16969:         ask_toggle_yacd_wan|do_toggle_yacd_wan|\
16970:         yacd_secret_menu|ask_yacd_*|do_yacd_*)
16971:             _handle_dns "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16972: 
16973:         community_lists|community_lists_edit|toggle_cl_*|\
16974:         r_dom_edit|r_sub_edit|del_rdom_*|del_rsub_*|\
16975:         fr_ips_edit|del_frip_*|\
16976:         excl_ips_edit|del_excl_*|\
16977:         cmd_add_fr_ip|cmd_add_excl_ip|cmd_add_r_dom|cmd_add_r_sub|\
16978:         user_domains_menu|user_domains_menu_p_*|\
16979:         user_subnets_menu|user_subnets_menu_p_*|\
16980:         cmd_user_add_*|cmd_user_del_*|cmd_user_download_*)
16981:             _handle_lists "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16982: 
16983:         do_cmd_stop|cmd_start|ask_cmd_stop|ask_reload_podkop|do_reload_podkop|do_close_connections|\
16984:         cmd_server_instances|\
16985:         cmd_tunnel_health|cmd_support_bundle|\
16986:         cmd_diagnostics|ask_upstream_health|ask_run_podkop_tests|ask_run_internal_diag|ask_support_bundle|\
16987:         ask_probe_outbound|ask_probe_outbound_status|ask_probe_outbound_px_*|ask_probe_outbound_url|cmd_probe_outbound_back_*|\
16988:         cmd_check_update_bot|ask_update_bot_*|do_update_bot_*|\
16989:         ask_restart_bot|do_restart_bot|\
16990:         ask_restart_router_1|ask_restart_router_2)
16991:             _handle_bot "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16992: 
16993:         ask_set_tr_menu|ask_set_tr_*|do_set_tr_*)
16994:             _handle_bot "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
16995: 
16996:         admins_menu|cmd_admin_add|ask_del_admin_*|do_del_admin_*|toggle_anon_admins|cmd_bot_invite_info|\
16997:         fallback_socks_menu|net_proxies_menu|cmd_fb_socks_add|cmd_test_fb_socks|ask_del_fb_*|do_del_fb_*|\
16998:         np_view_fb_*|np_view_bot|np_edit_fb_*|np_del_fb_*|np_del_bot)
16999:             _handle_fallback_socks "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
17000: 
17001:         ask_*)
17002:             local action="${cmd#ask_}"
17003:             local action_safe; action_safe=$(html_escape "$action")
17004:             local text; text=$(printf '%s <b>Подтвердите действие</b>\n\n<code>%s</code>?' "$E_WARN" "$action_safe")
17005:             local kb="{\"inline_keyboard\":[[{\"text\":\"${E_OK} Да\",\"callback_data\":\"do_${action}\"}],[{\"text\":\"${E_BACK} Отмена\",\"callback_data\":\"/menu\"}]]}"
17006:             send_or_edit "$mid" "$text" "$kb"
17007:             ;;
17008: 
17009:         *) _handle_bot "$cmd" "$mid" "" "" ;;
17010:     esac
17011: }
17012: 
17013: # ==============================================================================
17014: # SECTION 11: Startup & Main Event Loop
17015: # ==============================================================================
17016: 
17017: # ── Singleton guard ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
17018: # Kill any orphaned watchdog processes from a previous instance that survived
17019: # SIGKILL (procd can leave subshells running). The watchdog itself does not
17020: # hold the lock so it won't be blocked — only the main loop holds it.
17021: BOT_LOCK_FILE="${BOT_DIR}/bot.lock"
17022: BOT_PID_FILE="${BOT_DIR}/bot.pid"
17023: # NOTE: stopping previous instances is the init.d script's job (it kills the
17024: # main + forked children by cmdline). This process does NOT kill anything on
17025: # startup — that risked killing a legitimate running instance and masking
17026: # init.d problems. Single-instance is enforced purely by the lock-guard below
17027: # ("refuse to start if a live instance already holds the lock"). We only record
17028: # our PID here for the cleanup trap and external tooling.
17029: printf '%s' "$$" > "$BOT_PID_FILE"
17030: 
17031: # Clean up orphaned temp files from a previous run that was killed mid-cycle
17032: # (SIGKILL bypasses trap — these files are never rm'd by the dying process).
17033: # Only remove files older than 60s to avoid racing with a concurrent startup.
17034: find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'podkop_req.*' -o -name 'podkop_updates.*' \
17035:     -o -name 'podkop_clash.*' -o -name 'podkop_ip[1-5].*' \
17036:     -o -name 'podkop_pubip.*' -o -name 'podkop_socks_probe.*' \
17037:     2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r _stale; do
17038:     # mtime check: skip files touched in the last 60s
17039:     _st_mtime=$(date -r "$_stale" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
17040:     _st_now=$(date +%s)
17041:     [ $((_st_now - _st_mtime)) -gt 60 ] && rm -f "$_stale"
17042: done
17043: 
17044: logger -t podkop-bot "=== Podkop Bot v${BOT_VERSION} Starting ==="
17045:
